candidates.sentence: Max believes our only way out of this mess is to curb spending, lower taxes and get Americans back to work.

He proudly fights for the 7th District, is their voice in Congress, and is laser-focused on the issues that are hurting the district the most -- inflation, high gas and grocery prices, fentanyl overdoses caused by an unfettered southern border, supporting law enforcement, and bolstering American energy security.
He’s steadfast in his push to secure the southern border, expand workforce development opportunities, and empower Ohio and America’s farmers and rural communities.

to take meaningful action to end the crisis at the US-Mexico border such as resuming construction on the border wall, providing for an additional 22,000 Border Patrol agents, and bolstering local law enforcement jurisdiction along the southern border.
to cut reckless government spending, lift Americans out of poverty, and grow the economy.
